title: Execution of an instruction
statement: Given a vector $v:\{0,1,2\}\to\mathbb N$, an output instruction carrying a Boolean value produces the one-element list containing that value. A print instruction at position $t$ produces a list of $v(t)$ copies of true.
hypotheses_covered: A vector assigning a natural number to each of the three positions
An instruction, either an output carrying a Boolean value or a print at one of the three positions
